title: Timeline / Gantt

scenarios.title: Existing Gantt automated suite
scenarios.expected: The existing Gantt test project passes before any real-host acceptance.

scenarios.title: Create save reopen edit
scenarios.expected: A created Gantt remains editable after save, PowerPoint close and reopen.

scenarios.title: Copied Gantt is independent
scenarios.expected: Editing a copied Gantt does not mutate the original and both retain independent identity after save/reopen.

scenarios.title: Rendered WBS numbering follows hierarchy
scenarios.expected: Starting from tasks 4/5/6, indenting task 5 under 4 renders 4 / 4.1 / 5 on the slide; outdent/reorder recomputes immediately and save/reopen preserves it.

scenarios.title: Timeline has deterministic right outer edge
scenarios.expected: A right outer boundary exists exactly at the timeline extent and remains correct after rerender, resize, date-range change and copy.

scenarios.title: Interaktions-Semantik am Gantt (Office-automated Evidence)
scenarios.expected: Am echten Host aufgezeichnet: Dependency-Arrows fuer PredecessorLinks (arrows>=1) und Drag-Recovery via SyncFromSlide (dragSynced=true) ohne neue ErrorLog-Eintraege. Die End-Daten-Adoption verbreiterter Bars bleibt ein offener Fund (Ledger REG-GANTT-RESIZE-ADOPT-001; die Note meldet die Messwerte barWidth/duration), Undo/Redo ist im versteckten Automation-Host nicht verfuegbar (Owner-Leg LIM-GANTT-UNDO-001) - beide erscheinen als note, nie als Pass.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
